title: Desktop app source runs keep one profile per worktree, origin and instance; a release is prepared into a frozen manifest and published only after its checks pass
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test packages/desktop/tracy-desktop/test/dev-profile.test.mjs packages/desktop/tracy-desktop/test/release-preflight.test.mjs packages/desktop/tracy-desktop/test/server-contract.test.mjs packages/desktop/tracy-desktop/test/release.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the named tests below.
expect: Two worktrees, two origins and two instances give four different profile folders; a packaged app keeps Electron's own folder.
A second launch with an explicit TRACY_DESKTOP_INSTANCE on a busy profile fails loudly instead of driving the other process's window.
Preflight fails a dirty tree, a sha outside the channel branch, a sha without a successful Tracy CI run on exactly that sha, and a version not above the channel feed.

Prepare never writes a channel file and never builds a feed variant ad-hoc; publish writes the channel file exactly as the manifest froze it, refuses a wrong digest, a replaced artifact, a changed feed, a held lock, a second build of a published version, and stable without the stable key.
fence: devProfile() folder derivation and the second-instance decision; preflight(facts) check list

tests: two worktrees, two origins and two instances give four different folders
a packaged app keeps Electron’s folder and ignores both variables, even invalid ones
a second launch with an explicit instance fails loudly, naming the profile
a dirty tree fails, and names what is dirty
a sha that is not in the channel branch history fails
only a completed, successful Tracy CI run on exactly this sha counts
the candidate version must be strictly greater than the one on the channel feed
prepare uploads the artifacts and a manifest into <variant>/<version>/<build-id>/, and never a channel file
prepare stops before building when this machine has no Developer ID — never ad-hoc for a feed build
publish refuses a manifest whose digest is not the one given, and writes nothing
a second build of a published version is refused
publish refuses when the feed changes between its checks and its write
publishing stable without the stable key stops before touching the target
release notes that name a third party fail; effects pass; no notes is not checked
prepare refuses release notes that name a third party, before building
